enforcementNote: Outside audit mode the hook blocks only secret file reads and edits to the Hullproof hook files; in audit mode, in a trusted folder, the hook and plan mode block edits and shell commands outside a short read only list, but Gemini CLI loads none of it in an untrusted folder and continues the call if the hook exits with any code other than 2.
trustNote: Trust the folder when Gemini CLI asks, and approve the Hullproof hook when it warns about a new project hook.
firstRun: mkdir -p docs/security && touch docs/security/.audit-mode, then run: gemini --approval-mode=plan
